newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-RECORD ENTRY FOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-RECORD ENTRY FOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: A record 209 countries will compete at the world athletics championships in Athens in August, an increase of 17 on the 1995 event, organisers said on Monday.
Organising committee general manager Vangelis Savramis said some 3,400 competitors, coaches and officials were expected.

"They will arrive at a special terminal at Athens airport to avoid any delays. There are 110 days separating us from the championships and apart from minor problems everything is going smoothly," Savramis said.
He said 52,000 tickets would go on sale this week with the maximum price set at around $40. "The tickets are very cheap. We expect a packed stadium throughout the championships."
The championships are seen as a test of the Athens bid for the 2004 Olympics. The successful candidate will be announced in September.
